--external file format - parquet
use nyctaxi
GO

if not exists ( select 1 from sys.external_file_formats where name = 'fmt_parquet')
    create external file format fmt_parqet
        with (format_type = parquet,
                data_compression = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec');

--external file format - csv

If not exists(select 1 from sys.external_file_formats where name ='fmt_csv')
    create external file format fmt_csv
        with(format_type = DelimitedText,
        format_options(
            field_terminator = ',',
            string_delimiter = '" ',
            first_row = 2,
            use_type_default = false
        ));

--external file format delta

if not exists (select 1 from sys.external_file_formats where name = 'fmt_deltaformat')
    create external file format fmt_deltaformat
        with(
            format_type = delta);
